purpose: Prediction-aware diagnostic clear cases plus correct guards; not independent human gold, not representative, not a release gate.
freeze_status: Provisional old-reference development panel; contentious policy decisions require user/independent confirmation before new online comparisons.
selection_policy: Selected after historical predictions had been observed, by reviewed mechanisms and correct guards. This is NOT a blinded or prospectively preregistered comparison of those old predictions. Both repeats and all selected IDs are retained; exact unordered text pairs are deduplicated only in this small diagnostic panel, never in full evaluation. Freeze this selection before any future online comparison.
